decision.justification: Selected 'weighted on pool4 weighted by w2' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9096. Series context: trend strength 0.7728 and seasonal strength 0.1936; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.025); 2 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.559.
